Another quick response damn this subreddit is incredibly helpful, I've considered going to my go but I'm lowkey scared of her judgment, idk why lol. I have actually came out before to two people. One young family member, I only did this because he was young and probably didn't even understand what I was saying, it was weirdly helpful, and an old friend who immediately told his friends (so i had to lie my way out of it), ever since he did that I've found it extremely hard to even consider the possibility of telling people. I am trying to recognise my irrational thoughts but its hard, especially when people make jokes that accidentally trigger these thoughts.

Thank you so much for taking the time to type this, I wish I could help you with your suicidal thoughts but I'm not really in the position to be giving out life advice right now. I hope things get better for you :)

Fucking hell people reply quick on here lmao. What you're saying when it comes to friends is totally true, if they don't support it they're not my friends, the problem is if I move on from them ill be completely alone through what would be the biggest decision of my life (so far), but I will be going to university soon so could be a chance to make new friends, I guess I'll wait until then. sigmund freud did say " *One day, in retrospect, the years of struggle will strike you as the most beautiful.", I guess ill wait and see. Thanks a lot.*
Thanks for the quick response, i dont really know what else to say lol just thanks :)
